messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] Re: one or more cells is missing data
parts:
Good catch! Clearly ezANOVA should check whether the data have any
columns called "Freq" and take such columns into account if present
when checking for missing data. Added to the to do list:
https://github.com/mike-lawrence/ez/issues/21

Mike

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] Re: one or more cells is missing data
parts:
Ah, sorry, I should have noticed from your first message that you have
specified that Treatment is a within-Ss manipulation when, from
looking at your data, it is clearly a between-Ss manipulation. Time
would be a within-Ss manipulation. So you want to run:


ezANOVA(
data=data1
, dv=.(Survival)
, wid=.(Subj)
, within=.(Time)
, between = .(Treatment)
, type=3
)
